This example runs the real assistant: its conversation, memory and tools. The model is scripted and the storage lives in memory, so you need no credentials or network.

```sh
npm install @familiar-ai/core @familiar-ai/client
```

Familiar needs Node 24.19 or newer. Save this as `first-familiar.ts` and run it with `node first-familiar.ts`:

<Code code={firstFamiliar} lang="ts" title="first-familiar.ts" />

It prints the conversation:

```text
Sam: Hello
Familiar: Hello, Sam.
```

## What each part does

- **`fauxProvider`** is a scripted model provider. Each `setResponses` entry answers one model request. Use it in tests to drive the real harness without model calls. For a script that answers every request, such as a demo, `scriptedModels` from `@familiar-ai/core/models/scripted` hands it each request already read: a person's message, a tool's result, a due schedule or background work.
- **`MemoryStorage`** keeps everything in memory and loses it when the process exits.
- **`summonFamiliar`** opens the assistant over its storage, resumes any unfinished work and starts background work such as schedules and upkeep.
- **`send`** records a message from `author`. `requestId` should stay the same if you retry the same logical message, so it's admitted once.
- **`idle`** waits until every sent message has an answer.
- **`watch`** returns the committed conversation view, then streams each commit's changes. Stop it when you're done.
- **`toTranscript`** turns the view into the items a chat UI shows. It comes from the client package and is pure, so it works on the server too.
- **`dismiss`** closes the assistant. Always call it, so timers and connections stop.

## Make it last

Two things change for a real assistant:

1. **Persistent storage.** On Node, use `openNodeSqliteStorage` from `@earendil-works/pi-durable/storage/sqlite/node`. Install the exact Pi Durable version that core depends on, because Pi's storage format and types change between releases. On Workers, use [@familiar-ai/cloudflare](/familiar/build/cloudflare/).
2. **A real model.** Register a provider and give it credentials. That's the next page, [Models and sign-in](/familiar/build/models-and-sign-in/).
